problem: A Side-1 worker from the outgoing session can paint its result in the destination after a successful switch.
impact: The destination transcript and worker status can contain stale data from an earlier session, violating AC2.

problem: A foreground turn can start during asynchronous outgoing Slate preservation. Interactive resume now clears the busy flag even though the displaced foreground operation still owns its active token.
impact: Before the old token settles, a destination prompt can bypass busy dispatch and throw from foregroundOperation.begin. The prompt that started in the preservation window is also canceled by the successful adoption.

problem: Dismissing a busy recipient picker overwrites text typed while the decision journal opens the picker.
impact: A second piece of unsent text disappears on Escape although no recipient was selected.
